column6: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/api/dwmapi/nf-dwmapi-dwmsetpresentparameters : "Return value: This function always returns S_OK." (the parameters are a hint for a compositor; FIXME turned into TRACE in patch 5500)

FIXME is the final #else (non-Linux, no sysctl.h) of the function; the Linux branch reads /proc/sys/net/ipv4/ip_default_ttl and conf/default/forwarding (read_sysctl_int). test/nsi-gate.sh checks GetIpStatisticsEx forwarding (2 = not forwarding) and default TTL against those sysctls, 64- and 32-bit. wine-sg is Linux-only (CLAUDE.md: Debian, new WoW64 on amd64).

FIXME is the #else after the Linux (/proc/net/snmp 'Icmp:') and BSD sysctl branches. test/nsi-gate.sh: GetIcmpStatisticsEx InMsgs/OutMsgs lie between the kernel's counters read before and after an IcmpSendEcho to 127.0.0.1.

FIXME is the #else after the Linux branch (reads /proc/net/snmp6 'Icmp6*') and the BSD sysctl branch. Code read only: this container's kernel has no IPv6 (no /proc/net/snmp6), so the branch cannot run here; iphlpapi_test's IPv6 failures are identical to base.

FIXME is the #else after the Linux (/proc/net/snmp 'Ip:') and BSD branches. test/nsi-gate.sh: GetIpStatisticsEx InReceives/InDelivers/OutRequests lie between the kernel's counters before/after the probe's traffic, 64- and 32-bit.
FIXME is the #else after the Linux branch (reads /proc/net/snmp6 'Ip6*') and the BSD sysctl branch. Code read only: no IPv6 in this container's kernel.

FIXME is the #else after the Linux branch (/proc/net/arp) and the BSD sysctl branch. test/nsi-gate.sh: a static ARP entry made with ip neigh appears from GetIpNetTable2(AF_INET) as Permanent with its link-layer address on the right interface.

FIXME is the #else after the Linux branch (/proc/net/route) and the BSD NET_RT_DUMP branch. test/nsi-gate.sh: the default route and the on-link routes of both veth ends from GetIpForwardTable2(AF_INET) match ip route.
FIXME is the #else of #ifdef __linux__; the Linux branch reads /proc/net/ipv6_route. Code read only: no IPv6 in this container's kernel.

FIXME is the #else after the Linux (/proc/net/snmp 'Tcp:') and BSD sysctl branches. test/nsi-gate.sh: GetTcpStatisticsEx ActiveOpens/PassiveOpens/InSegs/OutSegs lie between the kernel's counters before/after a loopback connection.
FIXME is the final #else (neither Linux nor getifaddrs); the Linux branch reads /proc/net/if_inet6. Code read only: no IPv6 in this container's kernel (the table is only used for IPv6 endpoints).

On Linux both families return inside the #ifdef __linux__ branch (/proc/net/snmp and /proc/net/snmp6) and the family is checked at entry, so the trailing FIXME is unreachable. test/nsi-gate.sh: GetUdpStatisticsEx InDatagrams/OutDatagrams lie between the kernel's counters before/after a loopback datagram.
The stub is the #else of HAVE_LINUX_RTNETLINK_H; this build defines it (obj/include/config.h:197) and compiles poll_netlink (rtnetlink socket for address/link/route changes) instead.
